title: The Four Freed - How to Earn & Missable Status
description: The Four Freed trophy in Phantom Blade Zero - how to earn it, whether it is missable, and how the PS5 and Steam lists differ.
keyword: The Four Freed phantom blade zero trophy

sections.title: Overview
sections.content: One trophy hiding four fights, and the one that forces a detour into the Puppet Testing Grounds and the Mirage Estate. All four are named bosses with their own entity pages.

sections.title: How to Earn
sections.content: Defeat all four Great Puppets: Yuzan, Yubi, Yuding and Yucong.

sections.title: Source Status
sections.content: Trophy 5 of 36 on the list - before it All Dreams Must End · after it The Hunt. It is not missable, so a missed run can be finished later without a restart. The full list with rarity is on the trophy list; the Platinum route and the order to do things in are on the trophy guide.
